title: Old Chapel Road Rising
author: Tamsin Zhou
blurb: Zephyrine Iversen, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
